disclaimer: This file is data, not investment advice. It contains no recommendation to buy or sell anything.
whatThisIs: Two tables from DART (Financial Supervisory Service) ownership disclosures for Korean listed companies. 21,785 substantial-shareholding filings (majorstock) and 32,535 officer/major-shareholder ownership rows (elestock).
whatThisIsNot: Not investment advice or a recommendation.
Not a live feed. Each version is a snapshot as of its filename date; it does not update after publication.
Not a romanized name list. holder_name and person_name are printed exactly as filed — Korean text is left in Korean, not transliterated.
Not a full float table. This covers only names required to file (5%+ holders, officers, major shareholders), not every shareholder.
source: DART (Financial Supervisory Service) — majorstock (substantial shareholding) and elestock (executive/major shareholder ownership status) APIs

columns.name_en: English company name as filed with DART. Blank when DART has no English name on record.
columns.filing_id: DART receipt number (rcept_no). Unique per filing.
columns.filing_kind: "general" or "abbreviated" (일반/약식), from DART report_tp. "unmapped:<원문>" if a new value appears that this file has not yet mapped.
columns.holder_name: Reporting holder’s name exactly as filed. Not translated or transliterated.
columns.shares_change: Change in shares held versus the previous filing.
columns.stake_change_pct: Change in ownership percentage versus the previous filing.
columns.related_party_shares: Shares held by related parties acting together with the reporting holder.
columns.related_party_pct: Ownership percentage held by related parties.
columns.reason_raw_ko: Reason for the filing, original Korean text as filed. Not summarized or translated — we do not invent an English gloss for legal text.

korea-ownership-ledger-executives-2026-0.grain: one row per officer/major-shareholder ownership record (elestock)

columns.name_en: English company name as filed with DART.
columns.person_name: Person’s name exactly as filed. Not translated or transliterated.
columns.is_registered_officer: "registered" or "unregistered" (등기임원/비등기임원). Blank when DART reports neither (major shareholder who is not an officer).
columns.title: Job title as filed, original text.
columns.relationship: Relationship to the company as filed (e.g. major shareholder, executive), original text.
columns.shares_change: Change in shares held versus the previous filing.
columns.stake_change_pct: Change in ownership percentage versus the previous filing.
